title: The Cherlin-Zilber Algebraicity Conjecture for Simple Groups of Finite Morley Rank
exact_target: Must every infinite simple group of finite Morley rank come from a linear algebraic group over an algebraically closed field?

sources.citation: K. Tent, From the Cherlin-Zilber Conjecture via sharply 2-transitive groups to the Burnside problem, Abstract (2026).
